decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - There shall be no more than six car parking spaces on the site.

Condition : 4 - If within a period of five years from the date of this permission any tree or shrub which is shown on plans submitted as part of this application as a tree or shrub to be retained, or any tree or shrub which is planted in replacement for it, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies or becomes in the opinion of the local planning authority seriously damaged or defective, another tree or shrub of the same species and original size as that to be replaced shall be planted at the same place, unless the local planning authority gives its written consent to any variation.
description: Rearrangement of rear parking/amenity area to create 3 additional parking space for existing flats.
